(1st title) | award2_type = | award2_winner = | award3_type = | award3_winner = | award4_type = | award4_winner = | award5_type = | award5_winner = | previous = [[2003 Ballon d'Or|2003]] | main = [[Ballon d'Or]] | next = [[2005 Ballon d'Or|2005]] }} The '''2004 Ballon d'Or''' ({{lit|'''2004 Golden Ball'''}}), given to the best [[Association football|football]] player in Europe as judged by a panel of sports journalists from [[UEFA]] member countries, was delivered to the Ukrainian [[Striker (association football)|striker]] [[Andriy Shevchenko]] on 13 December 2004.{{cite web |last= The Guardian staff | url = https://www.theguardian.com/football/2004/dec/13/newsstory.sport7 | title = Shevchenko wins Ballon d'Or | date = 13 December 2004 | work = [[The Guardian]] }} [[Andriy Shevchenko]] was the third [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] to win the award after [[Oleh Blokhin]] ([[1975 Ballon d'Or|1975]]) and [[Igor Belanov]] ([[1986 Ballon d'Or|1986]]).{{cite web |last= Moore |first= Rob | url = https://www.rsssf.org/miscellaneous/europa-poy.html | title = European Footballer of the Year ("Ballon d'Or") | date = 21 January 2011 | work = [[RSSSF]] }} He finished top goalscorer in the [[2003–04 Serie A]], scoring 24 goals in 32 matches, as his team won the league title. The best ranked goalkeeper on the list was [[Gianluigi Buffon]] (Italy) with a 17th place (jointly with [[Traianos Dellas]], [[Fernando Morientes]], [[Frank Lampard]] and [[Didier Drogba]]). [[Ricardo Carvalho]] (Portugal) was the top ranked [[Defender (association football)|defender]] in the list, at ninth, while [[Deco]] (Portugal) was the top ranked [[midfielder]] at second place. ==Rankings== On 9 November 2004, was announced the shortlist of 50 male players compiled by a group of experts from ''[[France Football]]''.{{Cite news |date=2004-11-09 |title=Rooney nominated for Euro award |url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/3997467.stm |access-date=2025-12-19 |language=en-GB}}{{Cite web |last=Edisport |title=:.: Os cinco magníficos - Jornal Record :.: |url=http://www.record.xl.pt/arquivo/interior.aspx?content_id=216213 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140108095803/http://www.record.xl.pt/arquivo/interior.aspx?content_id=216213 |archive-date=2014-01-08 |access-date=2025-12-19 |website=www.record.xl.pt}} There were 52 voters, from Albania, Andorra, Armenia, Austria, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Belgium, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, England, Estonia, [[Faroe Islands]], Finland, France, Georgia, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Israel, Italy, Kazakhstan, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Macedonia, Malta, Moldova, Netherlands, Northern Ireland, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Republic of Ireland, Romania, Russia, San Marino, Scotland, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, Ukraine, Wales and [[Serbia and Montenegro|Yugoslavia]]. Each picked a first (5pts), second (4pts), third (3pts), fourth (2pts) and fifth choice (1pt).{{cite web |last= Pierrend |first= José | url = https://www.rsssf.org/miscellaneous/europa-poy04.html | title = European Footballer of the Year ("Ballon d'Or") 2004 | date = 26 March 2005 | work = [[RSSSF]] }} ===Voted players=== {| class="wikitable" style="font-size: 90%; text-align: center;" |- ! rowspan="2" | Rank{{Cite web |title=France Football |url=http://www.francefootball.fr/FF/ballon_or/bo_2004.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20051029064242/http://www.francefootball.fr/FF/ballon_or/bo_2004.html |archive-date=2005-10-29 |access-date=2025-12-19 |website=www.francefootball.fr}} ! rowspan="2" | Player ! rowspan="2" | Nationality ! rowspan="2" | Club(s) ! rowspan="2" | Total ! colspan="5" | Votes by place ! rowspan="2" | Votes |- ! 1st ! 2nd ! 3rd ! 4th ! 5th |- style="background-color: #FFF68F; font-weight: bold;" |1st |align="left"|[[Andriy Shevchenko]] |align="left"|{{flagu|Ukraine}} |align="left"|{{fbaicon|ITA}} [[AC Milan|Milan]] |175 |27 |5 |5 |2 |1 |40 |- |2nd |align="left"|[[Deco]] |align="left"|{{flagu|Portugal}} |align="left"|{{fbaicon|POR}} [[FC Porto|Porto]]
